metadata.case_name: SO SUP NG v. NG WAI HUNG AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_after: salesman in his uncle's trading company in Guangzhou
plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: sedentary work such as car park attendant or security guard

injuries.description: Segmental fracture shaft of right tibia
source: segmental fracture shaft of right tibia
X-ray showed segmental fracture shaft of right tibia
Fractured fibula at proximal 1/3 was also noted.
X-ray showed ... fracture right medial malleolus
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the ankle or foot

injuries.description: Infection of right shin / right leg with abscess requiring incision and drainage and removal of implants
source: Infection over right shin was detected on 3 December 2009.
He was admitted into PMH from 9 June 2010 to 22 June 2010 for right leg infection.
Incision and drainage of right leg abscess was performed on 9 June 2010.
Right leg wound debridement and removal of implants from right tibia was performed on 15 June 2010.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the knee or lower leg

injuries.description: Three deep lacerations over right leg
source: Physical examination showed grossly deformed right leg with 3 deep lacerations.
injuries.icd_description: Multiple open wounds of lower leg

manifestations.description: Right leg pain (intermittent, worse at night, 4-5 nights a week; pain up to 6-9/10)
Right knee and ankle stiffness, weakness and numbness
Residual right shin pain after walking for 30 minutes
Some stiffness of dorsiflexion of right ankle (mild to moderate)
Activities causing increased physical demand on right lower limb (prolonged standing, walking, squatting, stairs, running) cause discomfort or pain
Loss of confidence / fear to return to sports (swimming, soccer, cycling)

treatments_received: Taken to the Accident & Emergency Department (AED) of Princess Margaret Hospital (PMH)
Surgical toileting and suturing of wounds (10 September 2009)
Closed reduction and intramedullary nail fixation to right tibia (10 September 2009)
Closed reduction and screw fixation to right medial malleolus (10 September 2009)
Transfer to Caritas Medical Centre for rehabilitation (18 September 2009)
Physiotherapy and occupational therapy in rehabilitation centre
Incision and drainage of right shin abscess (5 January 2010)
Incision and drainage of right leg abscess (9 June 2010)
Right leg wound debridement and removal of implants from right tibia (15 June 2010)
24 sessions of physiotherapy in Tuen Mun Hospital from December 2009 to July 2010
3 sessions of occupational therapy in Tuen Mun Hospital from 13 April 2010 to 27 May 2010
Referral to vocational rehabilitation (10 March 2010; 28 July 2010)
treatments_future: No further surgery or specific treatment required (Dr Lam's opinion)

losses.description: Right leg injuries including segmental fracture of right tibia, fracture right medial malleolus and fracture shaft right fibula with residual pain, stiffness, weakness and numbness
Discomfort or pain on prolonged standing and walking; residual right shin pain after walking for 30 minutes

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Afraid and not confident to return to swimming, playing soccer and cycling
Right leg scar resulting from deep lacerations
